Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

U-MATH · has stage: The U-MATH v4 paper describes sourcing previously unpublished problems and solutions crafted by subject-matter experts for ongoing university courses through Gradarius, then filtering short-solution, multiple-choice and calculator-dependent problems.

candidate.normal12.u-math.primary-construction.v2

  • Previously unpublished and expert-authored are the paper authors’ provenance statements; original course materials and permissions were not independently audited.
  • Visual-problem selection additionally keeps only problems containing a single image.
  • U-MATH: A University-Level Benchmark for Evaluating Mathematical Skills in LLMsLocator: Creator primary source https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.03205v4; exact revision 2412.03205v4; raw response SHA256 713e0833c7646a528d927289a8fe502fffdd815c889802b724425bb72cec18e8; physical PDF page 4, separately extracted with pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8; one-based literal LF26-54 inclusive (terminal empty line counted if present). Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

U-MATH · evaluates: The U-MATH paper defines accuracy using an LLM judge against reference answers and considers a problem solved only when all questions in its statement are answered correctly and fully.

candidate.normal12.u-math.scoring.v2

  • This is the documented all-questions scoring rule, not an independent validation of judge accuracy or a partial-credit measure.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

U-MATH · human annotation: U-MATH construction uses several small language models to select difficult problems, followed by manual curation by in-house mathematical experts and the Gradarius team and review by university teaching experts.

candidate.normal12.u-math.selection-review.v2

  • Model-assisted difficulty selection and subsequent human review are different stages.
  • The precise selection statement concerns 150 challenging problems per subject; no uniform human-labeling multiplicity for every problem is inferred.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

U-MATH · dataset size: U-MATH is documented as 1,100 university-mathematics problems across six subjects; the v4 paper table distinguishes 900 textual problems and 200 problems with visual elements.

candidate.normal12.u-math.units.v2

  • The paper rounds its visual share to about 20%; the exact tabulated counts are 900 and 200.
  • U-MATH problem-solving tasks are distinct from the derived µ-MATH solution-judgment samples.
